card.name: Words just before an expected object
card.fires_on: Scattered words at points where a verb, object or phrase must continue, such as 'Anyone considering', 'asking them', 'his or her', or a comma after a challenge title. No single word type dominates.

modes.label: Anyone considering
modes.description: The word 'considering' after 'Anyone' in the antidepressant suicidality warning.
modes.example: Anyone<< considering>> the use of such drugs in a child

modes.label: Pronoun or noun awaiting continuation
modes.description: Object or pronoun words such as 'them', 'her' or 'people' that lead into a following clause.
modes.example: asking<< them>> to record where they saw turkeys.

modes.label: Other mid-phrase words
modes.description: Linking words, commas or partial words inside a phrase that is not yet complete.
modes.example: drugs known to be alkali lab<<ile>> should be avoided in admixtures.
